  ?enrollment edu:hasStudent ?student .

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

  ?module rdfs:label "AAA" .
  ?assessment a/rdfs:subClassOf* edu:Assessment .
  ?assessment edu:assessmentInOffering ?offering .
}
